Hi! Sorry for getting back to this so late.

I think this is a great idea, and will help string formats be faster (mostly from GDScript, but hey, who knows if it can be used elsewhere too!).

I have a few interface comments to start with. I'll try to keep in touch more actively if you're still up for updating the PR :)

Looks pretty good! Thanks for indulging my many structural comments :)

I've only really looked at interfaces so far. I'll try to get into implementation details for the next review!
